name: WWE LFG
description: Take an inside look at what it truly takes to make it in the WWE. Iconic WWE Legends such as Paul "Triple H" Levesque and Shawn Michaels and weekly regular coaches Undertaker, Booker T, Mickie James and Bubba Ray Dudley mentor a new generation in weekly matches on their quest to become the next WWE Superstars.

videos.title: This is WWE LFG
videos.overview: The Future Greats meet their legendary mentors, and show their skills on the mic and in the ring. Four select superstars have a match to control their destiny, while one WWE-hopeful's attitude could kill his chances at LFG glory.

videos.title: Legendary Teams
videos.overview: The top four superstars compete in a mixed tag match before a sold out LFG arena. The remaining members of the roster find out which WWE Legend will be leading them on their respective journey, and get some pointers in the ring before putting the advice to practice in a match with their peers and coaches as spectators.

videos.title: Verbal Takedown
videos.overview: The Legends get a double-dose of help from former colleagues and champions Brian "Road Dogg" James and Michelle McCool. One Future Great adds a finishing move to her developing repertoire, another finds out that sometimes a match can be unforgiving, and four new superstars fight for one LFG roster spot.

videos.title: Faction Frenzy
videos.overview: Former WCW President Eric Bischoff created the N.W.O., breaking new ground for sports entertainment. Bischoff and WWE Hall of Famer Sean Waltman challenge each LFG team to create a new faction to expand their individual and collective personas.

videos.title: Speak Your Truth
videos.overview: LFG gets a visit from controversial and charismatic WWE superstar CM Punk. "The Best In The World" joins the Legends to try to push the Future Greats on the mic and in the ring, as tensions continue to rise

videos.title: Stepping into the Spotlight
videos.overview: Several of the Future Greats prepare for a milestone event: their first ever match in front of a live audience! Who will shine under the bright lights? And who will crumble under the pressure?

videos.title: Toughness & Grit
videos.overview: WWE World Heavyweight Champion Gunther challenges the Future Greats to show more toughness and urgency in their matches. One Future Great is tasked with finding her dark side, while another is pushed to the edge when Bubba Ray Dudley makes a comment that cuts her to the core.

videos.title: Making Your Move
videos.overview: Tensions are at an all-time high as the competition reaches the halfway point. WWE Hall of Famer Diamond Dallas Page stops by to help the Future Greats develop new signature moves.

videos.title: Tag Team Turmoil
videos.overview: Bubba Ray Dudley brings in his brother D-Von to teach the Future Greats the art of tag team wrestling; the unexpected return of BJ Ray throws everything into disarray and causes complete chaos in the ring.

videos.title: Expect the Unexpected
videos.overview: The Future Greats are forced to navigate a difficult task and adjust on the fly to an unexpected malfunction. Meanwhile, tensions between BJ and Cutler reach a boiling point, and one of these competitors will be sent home for good.

videos.title: The Name Says It All
videos.overview: As the threat of elimination hangs over their heads, "The Phenomenal" AJ Styles lays down a challenge to the Future Greats; who can create a compelling nickname and live up to it in the ring?

videos.title: The Playoffs Begin!
videos.overview: The playoffs begin! Emotions run high, as the female future greats face off to see who will advance to the semi-finals, and who will be sent home.

videos.title: Who Wants It More?
videos.overview: The male future greats compete in the semifinal matches of the LFG playoffs. Two will move onto the finals at Madison Square Garden, while the other two will be forced to say goodbye.

videos.title: Win or Go Home
videos.overview: The Great Eight become the Final Four on the road to the Finals in New York City. But before battling it out in the ring, the Future Greats meet face-to-face in a series of epic promo battles where not even the Legends are safe.

videos.title: The LFG Finals
videos.overview: It's the LFG Finals from New York City! Which coach will be awarded the LFG Championship belt? And which Future Greats will become the newest members of NXT?

videos.title: Draft Drama
videos.overview: It's high drama during the LFG Draft! Sparks fly and tensions are at an all-time high, as unresolved issues between Drake Morreaux and Bubba Ray Dudley come to light.

videos.title: Better, Faster, Stronger
videos.overview: The Future Greats are switching it up, evolving their characters, and trying something new. Who will crumble under the added pressure?

videos.title: Good Vs. Evil
videos.overview: WWE Superstar Charlotte Flair stops by LFG, where the Future Greats impress The Queen in the ring and on the mic! Two alphas face off as Shiloh and Harlem go to war, while Sirena and Haze shine in the main event spotlight, and a hard-hitting showdown.

videos.title: Size Matters
videos.overview: Bayley and Summer headline this larger than life edition of LFG, as the Future Greats are tasked with using their size to their advantage. Dani, Elijah, and Chris are all underdogs hungry for a fight.

videos.title: Out of Your Comfort Zone
videos.overview: The Future Greats are tested like never before! Dani faces off against both Summer and her mom, Haze goes heel against a nicer P Nasty, and the main event ends with Drake and Elijah coming to blows backstage!

videos.title: Sink or Swim
videos.overview: Tensions are rising at LFG, as the ring may not be big enough to hold the egos of Harlem and Anthony. Penina and Zena go to war, but it's Serina and Bayley whose collision ends in injury.

videos.title: A New LFG
videos.overview: No teams, no points, no waiting for a NXT contract – it’s a new LFG!

videos.title: All on the Line
videos.overview: Things get heated in the first tag match of the season.

videos.title: What's in a Name?
videos.overview: LFG veteran Anthony Luke is back, but with a new name and new attitude.

videos.title: Walk on the Wild Side
videos.overview: The Future Greats receive a WrestleMania-sized lesson from Legend Terry Taylor.

videos.title: Knock 'em Out!
videos.overview: After a long injury hiatus, Elijah Holyfield is back!

videos.title: Perception is Reality
videos.overview: Newcomer Elio LeFleur battles Mike Derudder in an electrifying main event match.

videos.title: Crews Control
videos.overview: Elijah Holyfield takes on his mentor, Apollo Crews, in a hard-hitting matchup.

videos.title: A Brand New Zena
videos.overview: Chris Island puts in extra effort and looks to turn his fortunes around.

videos.title: The Apollo-Elijah Connection
videos.overview: Elijah Holyfield continues his relationship with Apollo Crews.

videos.title: Too Strong, Armstrong
videos.overview: Booker T has specific coaching instructions for Kali Armstrong and Layla Diggs.

videos.title: The Bodacious Belly Boys of LFG
videos.overview: Sirena Linton returns from her first live event tour to take on a PJ Vasa.

videos.title: Not Taking My Spot
videos.overview: Two massive men, with egos to match, lock horns in a hard-hitting main event.

videos.title: Who Dares Win
videos.overview: Nathan Cranton is ready to select a new ring name, but he may have jumped the gun.

videos.title: The Kam Hendrix Experience
videos.overview: PJ Vasa steps into the ring with her mentor - NXT Superstar Wendy Choo!

videos.title: Enter Van Dux
videos.overview: Harlem Lewis takes issue with Owens' feedback after a match with Harley Riggins.

videos.title: Pressure Is a Privilege
videos.overview: Johnny Gargano is back on LFG to coach Kali Armstrong and Chantel Monroe.
